journeys.setup: signed-in active member of the event's community on their own phone; one open single-activity goal (squats) with display authorized; one enrolled station screen watches the line
actions: open the event page and answer the device question with My own phone
press Move on my phone
enter a count, press Review, then Record
expected: the event's one activity stands selected and is said back as squats
Move on my phone opens /contribute/{goalId} with no kiosk Finish control
choosing the phone creates no place in any line
the receipt shows the member's own amount, and the shared total includes it exactly once
knownExclusions: Safari and native builds: not exercised; hosted Chromium only
a printed QR code: the event address is opened directly, not scanned

journeys.setup: signed-in active member on their own phone; the goal has at least one enrolled station screen showing Nobody is waiting.
actions: open the event page and answer My own phone
press Use a kiosk and leave the name box open without joining
type the name the screen should use, then press the join button
expected: nothing is in the line until the join button is pressed, and the station still reads Nobody is waiting.
after joining, the member's own queue page opens and the station counts them as a number
the station screen never shows the member's account name, the name they chose, or any identifier while they wait
knownExclusions: kiosk or station hardware: station screens are browser windows
how being called feels in a loud hall: owner device review

journeys.setup: two station screens enrolled as Station 1 and Station 2 on one goal; two members in line from their own phones, in a known order
actions: press Call next on Station 1, then on Station 2
on the second member's phone press I'm ready, then on the first member's phone
press Start their turn on both stations
enter 20 on Station 1 and 30 on Station 2 and record both
expected: Station 1 calls the first member and Station 2 the second, each by the chosen name and a three-character code, and the two codes differ
each phone shows its own station's code and Go to Station 1. or Go to Station 2., never the other's
a station's Start stays disabled until its own called member taps I'm ready; another member's ready does not open it
each station's result shows its own code with 20 squats recorded. or 30 squats recorded., and each phone's receipt shows its own amount
once the result clears, neither station shows any name or code from the finished turns
knownExclusions: printed station signage and kiosk hardware
the follow-along player's timing and feel: owner device review

journeys.setup: goal target 100 squats with a seeded 40 already recorded; one member on Move on my phone and two members mid-turn at Station 1 and Station 2
actions: record 15 on the phone, 20 at Station 1 and 30 at Station 2 at the same moment
expected: both station screens settle on 105 of 100 squats, 100% complete, 5 beyond our goal · still open
the phone, read fresh, shows the same shared total of 105
each of the three is recorded once: the settled total is exactly the seeded 40 plus 15, 20 and 30, and each device shows only its own amount
knownExclusions: a celebration or animation at the crossing: not part of this journey

that a station turn is recorded as the attempt that station started, and that the target crossing is recorded once for the goal and credited to no single member: stored facts the hosted screens do not show; proved on emulators by EXPO-ATTENDEE-JOURNEY-PROOF-1 (#563), not by this hosted journey

journeys.setup: one enrolled station mid-turn with a member who tapped I'm ready; the member's phone loses its connection
actions: on the station enter 25 and record while the station's network drops so the answer never arrives
press record again once
reconnect the phone
expected: the station keeps the same turn and the same count available to try again
the second press reports the same 25 squats recorded. and adds nothing
the shared total rises by 25 exactly once
while offline the phone claims no result; once reconnected it shows 25 squats recorded.
knownExclusions: the sentence the station prints for a lost answer: from this build (#564) the station maps it through the app's describeCallableError rule, so it prints a product sentence, That didn’t go through. Try again. or We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again., and never internal; proved on emulators by expo-attendee-journey J2b, not asserted by this hosted journey

journeys.setup: one enrolled station and three members in line one after another from their own phones
actions: first member: press Switch to my phone and record 10 there
second member: get called and do not answer for 45 seconds
third member: get called, tap I'm ready, then the station presses Let them go
expected: Switch to my phone opens the contribution screen for the same activity and the station stops counting them
the unanswered call ends with Your turn timed out on the member's phone and an empty station
Let them go returns the third member to You're not in the line with no receipt
only the switched member's 10 is recorded; neither of the other two records anything
knownExclusions: the 45 seconds are waited out for real on the hosted clock; how a no-show feels in a hall: owner device review

journeys.setup: one event with four enrolled stations: a member mid-turn at Station 1, a member who tapped I'm ready at Station 2, a member called to Station 3, and a member waiting while Station 4 is idle; a fifth member has the event page open with a name chosen; then the goal is closed
actions: enter 12 on Station 1 and record
press Start their turn on Station 2
tap I'm ready on the phone of the member called to Station 3
press Call next on Station 4
the fifth member presses join on the event page
expected: recording the turn started before the closure: Station 1 prints This goal is closed.
nothing is recorded and the shared total does not move
no member's phone shows a receipt
Start their turn is refused: Station 2 prints This goal is closed., shows no count to record and still serves the same member
I'm ready is refused: the called member's phone prints This goal is closed. and still shows them called to Station 3
Call next is refused: Station 4 prints This goal is closed. and serves nobody, and the waiting member's phone still shows them in the line
joining is refused: the event page prints This goal is closed., the member does not reach the queue page, and the hall's waiting count does not change
knownExclusions: that a refusal creates or advances no entry, place, assignment, lease or attempt document: stored facts the hosted screens do not show; proved on emulators by EXPO-CLOSED-GOAL-QUEUE-GATE-1 (#571, J4b and J4c) and the functions wsf-turn tests, not by this hosted journey
a goal that is closed and then reopened: reopening is not a product path, so each refusal here follows the one closure

whether the event page still offers Use a kiosk on a goal that is already closed when it loads: observed, not changed, by #571; this journey opens the page before the closure and asserts only that the join is refused

journeys.setup: a shared screen at the event with an authorized goal and a member who has an account
actions: start, sign in, record a contribution
press Finish
start again as the next person
expected: after Finish the screen is back at its start, signed out, with no previous person's name, email, own credit, receipt or pending record
the next person starts at the sign-in gate and their own credit reads zero, while the shared total keeps both people's contributions
left untouched, the countdown performs the same Finish and Stay puts it back
knownExclusions: kiosk hardware lock-down: this is in-app confinement, not a device lock
a mailbox: the walk-up uses an account that already exists
the 90-second countdown runs on the page's own clock, advanced in the browser, not waited out
